definitions.gloss: letting animals roam free; keeping animals free-range
definitions.explanation: Keeping animals without tying them up or penning them in, so that they move about freely. Used of pets let off the leash as well as of free-range livestock.

examples.english: to let a dog run loose

examples.japanese: {放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{産|う}んだ→産む：01899_umu⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I buy eggs laid by free-range hens.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Letting dogs off the leash is prohibited in this park.

notes:
From ⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧ (to let go) + ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep an animal), with the voicing ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ → が.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to let (an animal) roam free
- {放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧: free-range chickens
- {放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no unleashed dogs (sign)

USAGE:
Said half-jokingly of people left to their own devices: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to let children run free), ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|はな}し{飼|が}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give subordinates free rein).
